description: Search for rental vehicles at an airport or city. Returns available cars sorted by price with vendor, class, and rate details.

dropoff_datetime.description: Drop-off date and time in ISO format (e.g. "2025-03-20T10:00:00").

dropoff_query.description: Optional free-text drop-off location for a one-way rental, using the same formats as pickup_query. Omit for a round trip returning to the pickup location.

pickup_datetime.description: Pickup date and time in ISO format (e.g. "2025-03-15T10:00:00").

pickup_query.description: Optional free-text pickup location: airport IATA, metro IATA, city, address, point of interest, or "lat,lon". When present, this takes precedence over pickup_location and includes both airport and city-desk inventory. Keep pickup_location populated as a compatible airport, metro, or city value.

vehicle_class.description: Optional vehicle class preference: Economy, Compact, Standard, FullSize, Premium, Luxury, SUV, Van.

name: search_vehicles
